newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CM Telecom public tranche 3.6 times subscribed -TV.
newsitem.headline: CM Telecom public tranche 3.6 times subscribed -TV.

text.p: The public share portion of Hong Kong-based CM Telecom International Ltd's initial public offering was 3.6 times subscribed, state television said on Tuesday.

CM Telecom had offered 75.98 million shares at US$0.32 each as part of its listing on the new foreign board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore. CM Telecom is the first company to list on the foreign board.
Of the total, 65.8 million shares were new shares and the balance vendor shares.

The shares were offered in board lots of 7,000 shares. There were a total of 10,855 board lots. Of that, 2,171 board lots at $2,240 each were available for the public offer, while the remaining 8,684 were placed out privately at the same price.
State television said the private tranche was 100 percent taken up.
CM Telecom is a telecommunications company with cross-border paging services between China and Hong Kong.
